column6: I want water. I say: Please, give me water! You give me water. I drink the water. The water is good. Thank you!
I say yes. You say no. He says yes too. We say: yes, yes, yes! She says no. What is it — yes or no? It is yes!
Hello! I am here. You are there. I see you. You see me. We say hello. Hello! I give you water. You give me food. Good!
My friend is small. My friend is a child. My friend and I play. We read. We write. We learn. We say: good day, friend! Good day!
My mother is here. My father is there. Mother, father — I love you. We eat food. We drink water. The child sleeps. The night is good. Sleep, mother! Sleep, father!
It is day. I go to school. I learn. I read. I write. I say: when is night? Night is time for sleep. The night is good. I sleep.
The baby is small. My sister gives the baby an apple. The baby laughs. My brother runs and jumps. We play and sing. The baby dances! Mother says: good baby! The baby is happy.

Grandmother cooks. She cooks rice and eggs. The rice is hot. She gives me a cup of tea. I eat bread and an egg. Grandmother says: eat, child! The food is good. I wash my hands and my face. Thank you, grandmother!
My brother is small. He stands. He sits. He runs and jumps. Mother says: sleep now, child! My brother cries. Then he laughs. He sleeps. I laugh. Good, small brother!
The cat is black and white. A bird sits in the tree. The cat sees the bird. The bird goes. The cat runs. The dog runs. The bird is happy in the sky. The cat sits and sleeps. The dog laughs.

A big cloud is in the sky. Rain comes and the wind comes. I open the door and see the rain. The rain is cold and good. The flower and the tree are happy. Mother says: come in, child! I close the door.

Mother gives me a new shirt. The shirt is red. I see the shirt in the mirror. I dance! My sister washes the shirt with soap. Now the shirt is clean. My sock is old. I want new shoes. Father says: yes! We buy new shoes and a new cap. I am happy.

The farmer wakes in the morning. He gives the cow water and grass. The cow gives milk. The farmer walks to the village with the cow. In the village he buys bread and tea. The sun is hot. The farmer sees the river and drinks tea. A happy farmer, a happy cow!

The girl plays doctor. Her doll is sick. The doll has a hot head. The doctor touches the head and the hands. She says: doll, take the water and the apple! The doll sees the apple and smiles. Now the doll is good. Mother says: good doctor! The girl laughs and hugs the doll.

My father has a yellow kite. I run with the kite. The wind comes and the kite flies. The kite flies high in the sky. My friend sees the kite. She says: a beautiful kite! I give the kite to my friend. We laugh and we dance. The kite is happy in the sky.
